evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: NVD CVE-2019-20381: 'TestLink before 1.9.20 allows XSS via non-lowercase javascript: in the index.php reqURI parameter. NOTE: this issue exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2019-19491.' The CVE-2019-19491 fix (commit 0e3e90799) added `if (strpos($args->reqURI,'javascript') !== false) $args->reqURI = null;` in index.php::initEnv(). `strpos` is case-SENSITIVE, so a capitalised scheme (`Javascript:`) contains no lowercase 'javascript' substring, the guard never fires, and the value is reflected raw into <iframe src> where the browser executes it (URL schemes are case-insensitive). Closed in 1.9.20 (commit cde692895) by replacing `strpos` with case-insensitive `stripos`.
